brief.request: Render a fixed benchmark using the first flute and clarinet statements from Ravel's Bolero
brief.creative_summary: Four-bar introduction, Theme A on flute, two-bar link, then Theme A on B-flat clarinet over pizzicato strings and the fixed snare ostinato.

arguments.title: Bolero Rendering Benchmark - Flute and Clarinet

arguments.label: Theme A on solo B-flat clarinet

arguments.name: Solo B-flat Clarinet
arguments.role: second Theme A statement at concert pitch

rationale: Concert-pitch melody and rhythm were checked against the Nicolas Sceaux CC0 full score at https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/6/65/Bolero-ravel-nicolas-sceaux-cc0-domaine-public.pdf and cross-checked with public MusicXML. No electronic instruments are encoded in the authoritative score.
